about_the_game:
Plan fast, move faster — Bullet: Surge throws you into real-time bullet-dodging action! Adapted from the hit board game by Level 99, this fast-paced puzzle experience brings charismatic heroines to life, each wielding unique powers. Solo or online — the surge is coming!

Choose your Heroine

Each heroine wields a different power that changes how you experience the game! Whether you're batting bullets back, sniping, or unleashing mighty spirit bombs, every character offers a unique challenge and playstyle. Find your favorite... or master them all!

Inspired by the Hit Board Game

From tabletop to screen — Bullet: Surge faithfully adapts the popular Bullet board game, transforming it into an adrenaline rush, optimized for the digital experience. For purists and the curious, the Classic mode is also there for you to take up the original challenge!

Online and Solo Modes

Learn the ins and outs of your character and get to the top of the leaderboards in Score Attack, or fight each heroine's dangerous Boss mode, where that character's unique traits are turned against you in a thrilling strategic battle. Battle against your friends or players from all over the world online. Classic mode is also available, where you compete using the original board game's rules.

Dynamic Patterns & Skills

Build combos, deflect incoming chaos, and use your heroine’s powers to manipulate the board. Outwit your enemies — or be overwhelmed by the surge!

Colorful & Clean Visuals

Sharp, anime-inspired visuals keep the chaos readable, letting you focus on what matters: staying alive (and winning in style).
